# pass).
#
# Pass A: 60s root strace, idle.
# Pass B: 90s root strace, interactive (open Set, save Set, change track,
#         plug/unplug USB MIDI, tap pads, turn knob).

# === Notes ===
#
# Write paths (non-RDONLY opens + renames) seen in Pass B:
#   /data/UserData/UserLibrary/Sets/<uuid>/Set N/Song.tmp  (O_WRONLY|O_CREAT|O_TRUNC)
#   /data/UserData/UserLibrary/Sets/<uuid>/Set N/Song.abl  (renameat target)
#   /data/UserData/settings/Settings.json                  (O_WRONLY|O_CREAT|O_TRUNC, in place)
#   /data/UserData/Sentry/<uuid>.run/__sentry-breadcrumb1  (O_RDWR|O_CREAT|O_APPEND)
#
# Zero unlink/mkdir/symlink/link calls in either pass.
# Zero writes to /var, /run, /home, or /tmp.
